title: Nice Crunchy Greek Duck Baklava
description: A fresh and crunchy Greek dish featuring duck sauce, perfect for a cozy evening, this low-carb-friendly baklava is a unique twist on traditional desserts. It combines the savory flavor of duck with the sweetness of honey and the crunch of phyllo dough.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Layer the phyllo dough in a large baking dish, brushing each layer with melted butter.
Mix the duck sauce, honey, walnuts, pistachios, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
Spread the duck sauce mixture over the phyllo dough layers.
Repeat the layering process until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of phyllo dough on top.
Brush the top layer of phyllo dough with melted butter.
Bake the baklava for 45 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the baklava from the oven and let it cool completely.
Cut the baklava into diamond-shaped pieces and serve.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
